step1_figure.circuit_type: Synchronous Buck Converter with Bootstrapped NMOS Driver and Non-Overlapping Clock Generator
step1_figure.description: The netlist implements a step-down synchronous DC-DC buck converter consisting of an NMOS half-bridge power stage (xmu and xmd), an LC output filter (L1=100uH, C1=7.5nF, Rload=40 ohm), a break-before-make non-overlapping clock generator (SUB_1), and a bootstrapped high-side gate driver (Fig18_39 from Baker p. 546) to pull the high-side NMOS gate above the supply voltage Vs.

output_voltage.description: Steady-state average DC output voltage of the buck converter

equation.explanation: In continuous conduction mode (CCM), the average voltage across the inductor over a switching period is zero, relating the output voltage directly to the switching duty cycle D and supply voltage Vs.
equation.assumptions: CCM operation, ideal switches with negligible conduction loss

sky130_expected.calculation: Vs = 1.8 V; nominal duty cycle D = 0.5. Vout = 0.5 * 1.8 V = 0.90 V. Factoring in NMOS conduction drop of ~50 mV, Vout ≈ 0.85 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: With 50% duty cycle on 1.8 V supply, output targets 0.9 V minus finite switch Ron voltage drops.

output_voltage_ripple.description: Peak-to-peak voltage ripple at the output capacitor

source.reference: Eq. delta_Vout = (Vs * D * (1 - D)) / (8 * L1 * C1 * fsw^2)

equation.formula: delta_Vout = (Vs * D * (1 - D)) / (8 * L1 * C1 * fsw^2)
equation.explanation: Calculates the output capacitor voltage variation resulting from integrating inductor ripple current over the switching period.
equation.assumptions: Linear inductor current ramp, negligible capacitor ESR

sky130_expected.reasoning: At 5 MHz switching with 100 uH and 7.5 nF, ripple is low millivolt range.

inductor_current_ripple.description: Peak-to-peak ripple current through output inductor L1

equation.explanation: Calculates peak-to-peak inductor current during the high-side switch on-time.
equation.assumptions: Constant input and output voltages during on-time

sky130_expected.reasoning: Inductor current ripple is well below the ~22 mA average load current, ensuring continuous conduction mode (CCM).

filter_resonance_frequency.description: Natural undamped resonant frequency of LC low-pass filter

equation.explanation: Sets the corner frequency of the output second-order LC reconstruction filter.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined purely by passive components L1 and C1.

power_conversion_efficiency.description: DC-DC power conversion efficiency from input supply Vs to load Rload

equation.explanation: Ratio of average load power delivered to Rload to average power drawn from Vs and VDD supplies.
equation.assumptions: Evaluated in steady state over multiple switching cycles

sky130_expected.calculation: Pout = Vout^2 / Rload = (0.85)^2 / 40 ≈ 18.06 mW. Switching and gate drive loss ~2-3 mW, conduction loss ~1 mW. Total Pin ≈ 21.5 mW. eta ≈ 18.06 / 21.5 * 100% ≈ 84%.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Synchronous rectification avoids diode forward voltage drops, yielding typical efficiency around 80-88% in integrated CMOS.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench for synchronous buck converter to measure steady-state Vout, peak-to-peak ripple, inductor current ripple, load power, and efficiency.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Synchronous Buck Converter Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xmu=20u L_xmu=0.15u
.param W_xmd=20u L_xmd=0.15u
.param W_xm1i=1u L_xm1i=0.15u
.param W_xm2i=2u L_xm2i=0.15u
.param W_xm1a=1u L_xm1a=0.15u
.param W_xm2a=2u L_xm2a=0.15u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.15u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.15u
.param W_xm2=2u L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm1=2u L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm8=2u L_xm8=0.15u
.param W_xm11=1u L_xm11=0.15u
.param W_xm12=1u L_xm12=0.15u

VDD VDD 0 DC 1.8
Vs Vs 0 1.8

* 5 MHz clock, 50% duty cycle
Vin Vin 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 1n 1n 99n 200n)

xmu Vs N001 N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmu} l={L_xmu}
xmd N002 N003 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmd} l={L_xmd}
C1 Vout 0 7.5e-09
X_X1 Vin Vs N001 N003 SUB_1
L1 N002 Vout 0.0001
Rload Vout 0 40.0

.subckt SUB_1 In Vs Up Down
  X_X1 N004 Up Vs Fig18_39
  X_X2 N005 Down Vs INV_240_80
  X_X3 N001 N004 Vs INV_240_80
  X_X4 N003 N001 Vs INV_30_10
  X_X5 N007 N005 Vs INV_30_10
  X_X6 N006 N007 Vs INV_30_10
  X_X7 N002 N003 Vs INV_30_10
  X_X8 In N008 Vs INV_30_10
  X_X9 In N005 N002 Vs NAND_2
  X_X10 N001 N008 N006 Vs NAND_2
.ends SUB_1

.subckt Fig18_39 In Out VDD
  xm1i N001 In 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1i} l={L_xm1i}
  xm2i N001 In VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2i} l={L_xm2i}
  C2 N002 B 5p
  xm1a N002 N001 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1a} l={L_xm1a}
  xm2a N002 N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2a} l={L_xm2a}
  xm3 Out N001 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm4 Out N001 B B sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
  C1 N001 A 1p
  xm2 B A VDD 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
  xm1 A B VDD 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
.ends Fig18_39

.subckt INV_240_80 In Out VDD
  xm1 Out In 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
  xm2 Out In VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
.ends INV_240_80

.subckt INV_30_10 In Out VDD
  xm1 Out In 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
  xm2 Out In VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
.ends INV_30_10

.subckt NAND_2 A B Out VDD
  xm3 out B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm8 out A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm11 N001 B 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
  xm12 out A N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}
.ends NAND_2

.control
tran 1n 20u 10u

* Steady-state output measurements
meas tran vout_avg avg v(vout) from=15u to=20u
meas tran vout_max max v(vout) from=15u to=20u
meas tran vout_min min v(vout) from=15u to=20u
let vout_ripple = vout_max - vout_min
print vout_avg vout_ripple

* Inductor current measurements
let i_L = i(L1)
meas tran il_max max i_L from=15u to=20u
meas tran il_min min i_L from=15u to=20u
let il_ripple = il_max - il_min
print il_ripple

* Power and efficiency
let p_in = -i(Vs)*v(Vs) - i(VDD)*v(VDD)
let p_out = v(vout)*v(vout)/40.0
meas tran pin_avg avg p_in from=15u to=20u
meas tran pout_avg avg p_out from=15u to=20u
let eff = 100 * pout_avg / pin_avg
print pin_avg pout_avg eff

quit
.endc
.end
